captureTrees
  Saves trees as if the planter captured them, using a test image and skipping the camera and GPS wait. With no capture session running, the trees go in a new session that is ended straight away. If the app is in the capture flow, they are added to that session.
  - count (required): Number of trees to save, 1 to 500.
  - wallet (optional): Wallet (phone or email) of the account capturing the trees. Defaults to the device admin.
  - latitude (optional): Latitude to place the trees around. Pass with longitude. Defaults to the device's location while the app is open, otherwise 0.
  - longitude (optional): Longitude to place the trees around. Pass with latitude.
  - note (optional): Note saved on every tree.

createAccount
  Creates a planter account without the sign-up screens, using a test image as the selfie. The first account on a device becomes its admin, which skips the first-run setup flow on the next launch. Later calls add more accounts. Restart the app to see a new account.
  - firstName (optional): First name, at least 2 letters. Defaults to "Test".
  - lastName (optional): Last name, at least 2 letters. Defaults to "User".
  - phone (optional): Phone number of 7 to 15 digits to sign in with. Leave out phone and email to get a random unused phone number.
  - email (optional): Email to sign in with, instead of phone.
